leftEvidence.title: Covenant remembered for a thousand generations

points.label: Covenant setting
points.left: Several ancestral encounters are compressed into one line of covenant memory.
points.right: The covenant story continues through remembered promise rather than a new covenant ceremony.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: Abraham · Isaac · Jacob · Israel · Remember · Land · Covenant across generations
points.right: Isaac · Abraham remembered · Land · Presence · descendants · land · nations blessed · Promise carried across generation

payload.posture: Psalm 105 compresses the ancestral covenant that Genesis narrates as a renewed address to Isaac.
payload.tension: The two sources materially share covenant language or memory, while their parties, setting, action, or literary purpose remain distinct.
payload.title: The psalm remembers / Isaac receives
